title: Privacy Policy
description: What information Guidelark collects when you visit, how it is used, and the choices you have.
body:
This policy explains what happens to your information when you visit {{siteUrl}}.

## What this site collects

{{siteName}} is a static website. It has no user accounts and no comment system.

- **Cookies:** the site sets no cookies of its own. Google Analytics, described below, sets its own cookies.
- **Theme preference:** if you switch between light and dark mode, that choice is saved in your own browser so it is remembered next time. It is never sent anywhere.
- **Server logs:** the company that hosts this site may keep standard logs (IP address, browser type, pages requested) for security and reliability.

## Analytics and advertising

This site uses **Google Analytics**, a service from Google, to understand how many people visit, which articles they read, roughly where they are in the world (country or city level), what device and browser they use, and how they arrived (for example from a search engine or a link). This helps decide what to write next and what to improve.

Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technology to collect this information. It reports visits in aggregate. {{siteName}} does not receive your name or email address from it and does not try to identify individual visitors. Google processes this data under its own privacy policy: [How Google uses information from sites that use its services](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites).

You can stop Google Analytics from collecting your visits by:

- installing the [Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout)
- blocking or clearing cookies in your browser settings
- using a browser or extension that blocks tracking scripts

The site does not show advertising at the time of the last update shown above. If advertising is added, this page will be updated first.

## Email

If you email {{email}}, your address and message are used only to reply to you.

## External links

Articles link to other websites, which have their own privacy policies.

## Changes

Any change to this policy will be published on this page with a new date.

## Contact

Questions about privacy can be sent to [{{email}}](mailto:{{email}}).
